commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/final-storage-docs-audit
EXPECTED=dc578feb4255552db221ffc694312d236c390daa
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
git checkout "$BRANCH"
git reset --hard "origin/$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomaps-ruff-XXXXXX)
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q ruff==0.8.4
"$VENV/bin/ruff" format backend/app/tests/contracts/test_nullable_original_path_migration.py
"$VENV/bin/ruff" format --check backend/app/tests/contracts/test_nullable_original_path_migration.py
rm -rf "$VENV"
git diff --check
git diff -- backend/app/tests/contracts/test_nullable_original_path_migration.py
if git diff --quiet; then
  echo ruff_no_changes
else
  git add backend/app/tests/contracts/test_nullable_original_path_migration.py
  git commit -m "Apply Ruff formatting to migration test"
  git push origin "$BRANCH"
fi
echo formatted_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
